title: enterprise secret set|remove|status --json
description: `enterprise secret set|remove|status --json`. Linux and macOS set and remove write (or remove) the credential and run ensure under one lifecycle lock, and print lifecycle result v2 with action ensure (runEnterpriseSecret, internal/cli/enterprise_unix_run_unix.go); an identical value is not rewritten, and a failed write is errors[0].code change_failed. Their argument, privilege and value errors before the lifecycle runs print no JSON (management-agent.md section 2.3). Windows set and remove (internal/cli/enterprise_secret_windows.go) take bundle.lock (waiting up to --lock-wait), then the installer's lifecycle.lock (waiting up to 30 s), write the credential, restart the gateway, and with --json print one schema-1 document on every outcome, success or failure; argument and flag errors exit 1639. Every Windows set writes and restarts, so the agent sends a credential only when its sha256_prefix differs. Windows builds without management_contract take no lock and print the success document only. status (every OS, no lock, read-only) lists name, present, sha256_prefix (the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 of the stored value; Windows hashes the value with surrounding whitespace trimmed, Linux and macOS the stored bytes), modified_at and, on Linux and macOS, mode.

gateway_restarted.description: false only when the gateway was not running (restartWindowsStandaloneGateway).

name.description: As given; absent when --name was missing.

errors.description: elevation_required (exit 5 on a managed computer, 1603 on a computer without the standalone deployment marker); invalid_arguments (1639: bad --name, not exactly one of --from-stdin/--from-file, empty or oversized value, unknown flag); lifecycle_busy (1618: bundle.lock not free within --lock-wait, or lifecycle.lock not free within 30 s; nothing was written, retry); not_installed (1603: no standalone deployment); credential_in_use (1603: remove while the installed config references it); change_failed (1603: write or remove failed, nothing changed); restart_failed (1603: the credential was stored or removed but the gateway did not restart; resubmit the same call); state_invalid (1603, also when the installer's lifecycle.lock file does not exist).

errors.message: another DefenseClaw lifecycle run holds lifecycle.lock; the credential was not stored and the run can be retried
